task.description: Validate the ISS-0076 fix design (GitHub #335): GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql's to_regclass('instance_projections') guard always fires because GBL migrations only run against public and instance_projections was dropped from public by GBL-073, so the secrets table has never been created. Verify acceptance-criteria coverage, absence of implementation code, migration-number collision, root-cause accuracy against source, and necessity of a corrective migration.
acceptance_criteria: Every AC in the GitHub issue has a corresponding design element
No implementation code present in the design
Proposed GBL-101 filename does not collide with existing migrations
Root-cause explanation verified accurate against src/db/migrations.zig and GBL-073
Design correctly identifies that a corrective migration is required, not optional

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/iss-0076-secrets-table-migration-fix.md validated against migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql, migrations/GBL-073_tnt01_drop_legacy_public_business_tables.sql, src/db/migrations.zig (lines 196-207, 258-273), and docs/anti-patterns.md line 48. All factual claims confirmed accurate: GBL- migrations skip non-public schemas (migrations.zig:203-207); GBL-073 drops both instance_projections (line 69) and webhook_subscriptions (line 59) from public via CASCADE. Acceptance-criteria table covers all 4 GitHub issue ACs with concrete design elements. No implementation code present beyond short illustrative fragments used for explanation. GBL-101_exp501_secrets_corrective.sql does not collide with any existing file (highest existing is GBL-100) and fits the GBL-NNN_slug convention. Design correctly explains that schema_migrations already marks GBL-100 applied, so in-place edits will not re-run and a corrective migration is genuinely necessary.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 03) to implement the fix per design
